questions.qPa: 'ਦ ਫੇਰੀ ਕੁਈਨ' (The Faerie Queene) ਕਿਸਨੇ ਲਿਖੀ ਸੀ?
questions.explanation: Edmund Spenser wrote 'The Faerie Queene', an epic poem and fantastical allegory celebrating the Tudor dynasty and Elizabeth I.

questions.q: Identify the figure of speech: 'The camel is the ship of the desert.'
questions.qPa: ਅਲੰਕਾਰ ਦੀ ਪਛਾਣ ਕਰੋ: 'ਊਠ ਮਾਰੂਥਲ ਦਾ ਜਹਾਜ਼ ਹੈ।' (The camel is the ship of the desert)
questions.explanation: It's a metaphor because it directly compares the camel to a ship without using 'like' or 'as'.

questions.q: Which of the following is not a principle of language teaching?
questions.explanation: Dictation is a technique or activity, not a fundamental principle of language teaching like motivation, imitation, or practice.
